# CutHaven - Premium Outdoor & Garden Tools

CutHaven is your trusted source for premium outdoor, garden, hand, and power tools in the United States. We source quality equipment from manufacturers we trust and back every order with a 40-day return window and 12-month warranty.

## Key Features

- Free shipping on orders over $350
- 40-day hassle-free returns
- 12-month manufacturer warranty on all tools
- Ships within the United States only
- Secure checkout with multiple payment options (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Amex, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay)
